name: Brine Rat Cavern
accessNote: Enter by digging with a spade south of the windswept tree east of Olaf Hradson (accessible during and after Olaf's Quest); fairy ring DKS is nearby. Contains 7 Brine rats in a single combat zone; a dwarf multicannon may be used, and two safespots exist (the black bones to the south-east and the north-west corner).
